purpose: Test whether the low-dimensional conditional latent-mean bias that survived V22 is the causal, trainable defect, without changing representation, capacity, data, sampling, or field thresholds.

single_change.description: Add one per-sample, per-frozen-m-bin conditional denoising-mean penalty to the byte-identical V22 objective.
single_change.m_bin_edges: the 11 full edges defining the 10 frozen V21 conditional-profile bins
single_change.per_sample_bin_error: Delta_ib = mean over voxels in bin b of (D_i - x0_i)
single_change.conditional_loss: batch mean of EDM_weight_i times mean over valid bins of Delta_ib squared

inherited_byte_identical: CosineAnnealingLR over 30000 steps and minimum learning rate
field evaluator, Q3/Q4/Q5 definitions, and thresholds

validation.selection_metric: the unchanged balanced validation metric and RNG stream

fixed_conditional_validation.weights: same EDM weight and max-bin absolute Delta definition as training diagnostic

diagnostics_and_selection.selection: smallest candidate passing every unchanged V6 field check plus Q3, Q4, and the new Q6-std no-harm check independently in all three domains
diagnostics_and_selection.Q6_latent_mean: original residual and forward-mapped latent conditional mean profiles; diagnostic only and selection_role none

Q6_std_no_harm.definition: per domain, maximum over frozen m bins of abs(generated_over_truth_std - 1)

diagnostics_and_selection.swift_no_harm: Swift must retain the unchanged field gate and Q3/Q4 pass and satisfy Q6-std no-harm at the selected candidate

failure_classification_at_step_30000.condition: maximum absolute latent Q6 mean error <= 0.05 in every domain but Q3 or Q4 fails
failure_classification_at_step_30000.next: audit capacity or a frozen second-moment objective

failure_classification_at_step_30000.condition: maximum absolute latent Q6 mean error >= 0.10 in any domain
failure_classification_at_step_30000.next: audit formula, binning, gradients, and optimization before any new experiment

failure_classification_at_step_30000.condition: maximum absolute latent Q6 mean error is strictly between those bounds
failure_classification_at_step_30000.next: classify by the frozen Q3/Q4 and Q6-std outcomes without tuning

fixed_decision_order: implement and unit-test the frozen binning and loss before execution
train one model from scratch on Lageunha Ada with no mid-run changes
select the smallest all-domain pass and stop before any independent-data access
otherwise apply the frozen failure classification and stop with Astrid unopened
never extend the horizon, tune lambda, alter thresholds, or rescue a near miss after results

approval_firewall.Astrid_access: forbidden until development pass, committed seal, and explicit user approval
